scripts.bootstrap: node scripts/bootstrap-env.mjs && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && uv sync --project apps/backend --extra dev
scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project apps/backend python -m uvicorn app.main:app --loop app.core.runtime:create_event_loop --reload
scripts.start:backend: uv run --project apps/backend python -m uvicorn app.main:app --loop app.core.runtime:create_event_loop --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.db:status: uv run --project apps/backend python -m alembic -c apps/backend/alembic.ini current
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/backend python -m alembic -c apps/backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.threads:install: uv run --project apps/backend python -m playwright install chromium
scripts.lint:backend: uv run --project apps/backend python -m ruff check apps/backend/src apps/backend/tests
scripts.test:backend: uv run --project apps/backend python -m pytest -c apps/backend/pyproject.toml apps/backend/tests
